title: How do you write the numbers of the marked negative flags?
description: Three marks stand to the left of zero on the number line. Counting the steps from zero to each mark gives its negative number, which is written in a box with its minus sign.
teaching_notes: One idea: a mark n steps to the left of zero is the number negative n, so the minus sign must be written. Watch for students who drop the minus sign and write only the count of steps.

video_script.why: The child reads the three marked negative numbers from the number line and writes each in a box with its minus sign.
video_script.substitution: The book's own number line from negative ten to ten, with three marks to the left of zero.
video_script.anchor: the number line of the book from negative ten to ten, with three marks to the left of zero
video_script.payoff_line: Each box holds the number with its minus sign.

final_answer.value: Depends on the marks of the first question; for example -7, -3, -1
final_answer.spoken: it depends on your marks, for example negative seven, negative three, negative one

maths_rules: a mark n steps to the left of 0 is the number -n
example marks: 7 steps left is -7, 3 steps left is -3, 1 step left is -1
check: all three are left of 0, so each has a minus sign; -7 < -3 < -1
